name: Bloodrager
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s bloodrager class levels gains the bloodrager‘s bloodrage class feature. When determining the benefits of their rage and the number of rounds per day they can rage, the apprentice’s effective bloodrager level is equal to half his apprentice level (minimum 1).

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s bloodrager class levels and chooses bloodrager for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the bloodrager‘s bloodline class feature. The apprentice must select the same bloodline as his mentor. When determining which bloodline powers the apprentice gains and the effects of those bloodline powers, the apprentice’s effective bloodrager level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3. The apprentice adds all bloodline spells available to a bloodrager of his effective bloodrager level would learn to his list of spells known. The apprentice doesn’t gain any additional class skills or bonus feats from his bloodline.

Cooperation Power

Apprentices who study a mentor’s bloodrager class levels and chooses bloodrager for their cooperation power may, as a free action, spend a cooperation point to allow any ally or themselves to use Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skills, or abilities that require patience or concentration while raging. This ability lasts until the start of the apprentices next turn.
